relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that downregulation of SIRT1 induces pain by increasing histone acetylation at the Scn3a promoter regions and subsequently increasing transcription.

relationships.subject: Nav1.3
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrate that increased expression of Nav1.3 in the SDH leads to the excitement of CaMKIIα+ neurons, which in turn induces pain.

relationships.subject: Nav1.3
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of its expression relieves pain, while overexpression induces pain.

key_findings: Spinal SIRT1 decreases after CCI, raising histone H3 acetylation at the Scn3a promoter and increasing Nav1.3.
Nav1.3 activates spinal CaMKIIα+ neurons causing neuropathic pain.
